about: Date corrections to the published history of india-law: every Act version found misdated and the labelled correction (Kind: correction) that gives its first day. A correction is found by its Corrects trailer (act path and range); "misdated" is the version it restates, unchanged. Written by runners/in-acts-fix/build_fix.py; see tools/on.py.

corrections.evidence: S.O.561(E) of 2003-05-20 (commencement notification, Gazette Id in.gazette.central.e.2003-05-20.24588): appoints 2003-05-20 for section 3 (in part) and sections 4 to 66 (some in part)
corrections.reason: misdated: dated by G.S.R.410(E) of 2019, which brought into force only section 2 so far as it amends section 71 of the Patents Act; most of the Act came into force on 2003-05-20 (S.O.561(E))

corrections.evidence: s.1(2): the provisions other than sections 7 and 80 come into force at once, i.e. on 2000-12-13, the assent day printed in the Gazette (in.gazette.central.e.2000-12-14.054)
corrections.reason: misdated: dated by S.O.176(E) of 2001, which brought into force only section 7; section 1(2) brings every other provision into force at once, on 2000-12-13
